name: WiFi Cracking
description: WiFi network scanning, handshake capture, and WPA/WPA2 cracking tools.
author: Suijin

wifi_scan.description: Scan for nearby WiFi networks and return BSSID, channel, signal strength, and encryption type.

parameters.interface: Wireless interface (e.g. wlan0, en0). Default: auto-detect.

wifi_capture.description: Capture WPA handshake for a target network. Requires a client to connect or deauth.

parameters.timeout: Seconds to wait for handshake. Default: 60.

wifi_crack.description: Attempt to crack a captured WPA handshake using a wordlist.

parameters.handshake_file: Path to .cap file with captured handshake.

sudo_available.description: Check if passwordless sudo works for wifi tools.
